newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Primakov to visit Iran on December 22-23.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Primakov to visit Iran on December 22-23.

text.p: Russian Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov will visit Iran on December 22 to 23 and will hold talks with Iranian Foreign Minister Ali Akbar Velayati, a ministry spokesman said on Friday.
The spokesman gave no further details but Interfax news agency said the two sides would discuss a wide range of issues, including regional crisis points.
Interfax said Primakov would also meet President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani and other senior officials during his visit to Tehran.

Iran and Russia have good political ties and earlier this month signed an agreement in Moscow to expand their economic cooperation. Tehran agreed to buy tens of millions of dollars worth of Russian subway cars and technical equipment.

Both countries have expressed concern over recent fighting in Afghanistan and the former Soviet republic of Tajikistan, and are also closely involved in talks on the future of the oil-rich Caspian Sea.
